code_identity_contract.submission_value: EXPECTED_COMMIT is the full 40-character candidate SHA supplied to qsub
code_identity_contract.required_equality: EXPECTED_COMMIT == clean worktree HEAD == manifest identities.code.commit

frozen_workload.optimizer: AdamW with initialized first and second moments

adoption_boundary.event: LearnerRuntime invokes adoption only after backward clipping optimizer.step scheduler.step and zero_grad
adoption_boundary.copy_scope: ordered parameters of one verified target fragment
adoption_boundary.counter_reset_scope: target fragment local steps and processed input tokens only
adoption_boundary.moment_policy: preserve all optimizer state by default
forbidden_conditions: waiting for a writer syncer quorum or other fragment
application data exchange through MPI collectives sockets RPC or NCCL

identity_audit.parameter_hash: SHA-256 of each ordered fragment serialized as little-endian fp32 immediately before and after application
identity_audit.optimizer_hash: canonical SHA-256 over every ordered parameter optimizer-state key type shape dtype and exact tensor bytes immediately before and after application
identity_audit.comparison_points: inside the same safe-boundary callback around the target-only parameter copy and counter transition
identity_audit.target_rule: target after hash equals SHA-256 of the verified FragmentGlobalState parameters
identity_audit.non_target_rule: all non-target parameter hashes and all optimizer hashes remain identical

latest_only_and_bounded_state.polling: one background worker reads only the F fixed global-current slots and verifies compound payload identities and checksums
latest_only_and_bounded_state.pending_bound: one latest-wins complete pending state per fragment
latest_only_and_bounded_state.eventually_readable_retry: PublicationNotReady is retried without stopping the worker while identity schema and version regressions remain fatal
latest_only_and_bounded_state.direct_jump: one application may advance v directly to any observed v+k and reports k-1 skipped intermediate versions
latest_only_and_bounded_state.resident_trace_bound: one latest adoption trace per fragment plus aggregate counters

mixed_version_loss_window.start: the first optimizer step whose pre-step model version vector is mixed after an adoption
mixed_version_loss_window.predicate: every token-weighted loss is finite and local optimizer steps are consecutive
forbidden_aggregation: using the adoption boundary's pre-adoption loss as post-adoption evidence

adoption_lag.production_trace_join_key: fragment index target version and global content identity
adoption_lag.step_lag: safe-boundary local step minus first verified-discovery completed-step snapshot
adoption_lag.time_lag: writer publication-completion time.time_ns joined to adoption time.time_ns in the formal analyzer

transfer_intervals.fs_to_cpu_seconds: monotonic duration of fixed-slot read plus payload verification
transfer_intervals.cpu_to_gpu_seconds: monotonic duration of validated target-fragment tensor copies with CUDA synchronization when applicable

run_identity.config_identity: raw SHA-256 of the frozen JSON profile
run_identity.model_identity: runtime logical-layer registry digest from the frozen seeded model
run_identity.fragment_map_identity: runtime FragmentMap digest from the same registry and fragment count
run_identity.state_identity: run config model map descriptor version and content identities validated by GlobalStateStore

formal_package: S1-00 builder finalizer and validator with clean code config source skill scheduler GPU role path and checksum identities plus fail-if-exists root
failure_ladder: preserve the first formal L2 package; reproduce writer and learner on one compute node with the same candidate and profile before any resubmission
